summons: Bear (class companion, from the mat, not a card): HP 10/12/14/16/18/20/22/24/26 at levels 1-9 (8 + 2 x level), Move 3, Attack 2. Summoned in an empty adjacent hex before the first round of every scenario; acts immediately before the Wildfury each round; the Wildfury may lose cards to negate damage done to the Bear; below 1 HP it is removed and cannot return that scenario; won't open doors on its own turn but can be commanded to. GHS two-mini: health 8+Lx2, attack 2, movement 3 (agrees).
Wind Idol (Gust Sigil top, level X): HP 1 [square], Move -, Attack -, Range -; "All allies within Range 3 add Pierce 1 to all their attacks."
Monolith (Stone Sigil top, level 3): HP 2 [square], Move -, Attack -, Range -; "All allies within Range 3 gain Shield 1."
Vital Force (Spirit Sigil top, level 9): HP 3 [square], Move -, Attack -, Range -; "All allies within Range 3 add +2 Attack to their first attack each round."
mechanics: Bear companion from the mat: auto-summoned before round 1, acts right before the Wildfury, HP 8 + 2 x level, the Wildfury may lose cards to negate the Bear's damage, can't return once killed

COMMAND halves: the Bear performs the half's abilities, ignoring the Wildfury's line of sight (Maul, Howling Bolts bottom, Gnaw, Disorienting Roar top, Spirit Swap top, Invocation of Endurance bottom, Forceful Swipe, Energizing Strike top, Punch Through, Unstoppable Beast, Rampage, Blood Hunger, Unleashed Fury, Lash Out top, Jaws of Death); a Command can also make the Bear open doors

Required element consumes ('!' box with a consume icon at the top of the half): the action can't be performed without the element (Disorienting Roar bottom, Invocation of Endurance/Spirit/Domination/Absorption tops, Gust/Stone/Spirit Sigil tops)

Split element icon (one pill, Air | Earth) for consume and infuse, distinct from two separate icons (Spirit Swap top, Invocation of Spirit top, Ancient Ward bottom, Unbreakable Bond top, Spirit Sigil bottom); read as 'one of the two'

Invocation pattern: use-slot persistent triggered after each of the Bear's next N attacks, max once per round (Disorienting Roar bottom: command Move 3 Jump; Invocation of Endurance: command Heal 2 self; Invocation of Spirit: attack from the Bear's hex; Invocation of Domination: control the attacked enemy Move 2 Attack 2; Invocation of Absorption: damage 1 around the Bear and Bear heals X)
Attacks measured as if the Wildfury occupied the Bear's hex (Invocation of Spirit top, Unbreakable Bond top)
Static summons with auras and no move/attack (Wind Idol: Pierce 1 to allies within 3; Monolith: Shield 1 to allies within 3; Vital Force: +2 Attack on allies' first attack each round)

Bear-conditional bonuses: Retaliate 1 if the grant target is the Bear (Focused Aggression bottom), +1 Heal if the target is the Bear (Invocation of Spirit bottom), attack only if adjacent to the Bear (Stone Sigil bottom)
Position swaps by teleport: two enemies (Spirit Swap bottom), the Wildfury and the Bear (Lash Out bottom); teleport the Wildfury to an adjacent empty hex via a consume (Spirit Swap top)
Damage-token counter card fed by the Bear's attacks and Retaliate damage (Concentrated Rage bottom)
Grant abilities to allies: Shield 1 (+Retaliate 1 for the Bear) (Focused Aggression bottom), Shield 1 plus Poison around the granted ally (Invocation of Domination bottom)
'If you performed the attack ability, perform:' follow-ups (Energizing Strike top, Blood Hunger top)
Mandatory end-of-round lose check: lost if no attack made or received that round (Blood Hunger bottom)
Double Attack bonuses from ability cards on one attack (Unleashed Fury top)
Kill-to-repeat: XP 1 and repeat the action on a kill (Jaws of Death top)
Turn skip: three rounds of no card selection or turn for the Wildfury, the Bear takes two turns at initiative 14 (Unbreakable Bond bottom)
Conditions used: Disarm, Regenerate, Poison, Muddle, Wound, Immobilize, Strengthen, Bless; plus Retaliate, Shield, Pierce, Push
unclear: Split element icon (one pill, Air | Earth, one red X or none): I read it as 'Air or Earth, one of the two', because Ancient Ward prints both notations on one card (top: two separate icons each with a red X = both). Confirm with the 2e rulebook (Spirit Swap top, Invocation of Spirit top, Ancient Ward bottom, Unbreakable Bond top infusion, Spirit Sigil bottom infusion)
